headline: President Obama created a national commission to study the BP Deepwater Horizon oil spill and offshore drilling.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a national commission focused on the BP Deepwater Horizon oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico and on offshore drilling more broadly. Based on the title, the commission's job was to look into the spill and offshore drilling. No summary was provided, so details about its members, powers, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Offshore oil and gas drilling companies
who_it_affects.how: Their industry and practices were the subject of the commission's review.

who_it_affects.group: People and communities along the Gulf Coast
who_it_affects.how: The commission studied the oil spill that affected their region.
